ChatGPT said:

You should not connect frontend directly to MySQL.

Correct flow is:

Frontend form → Backend server (Node.js/Express) → MySQL database

That is how registration data gets stored safely.

Here is the full setup for your event registration project on your laptop.

1. Create the MySQL database

Open MySQL Command Line Client or MySQL Workbench and run this:

SQL
CREATE DATABASE event_registration_db;

USE event_registration_db;

CREATE TABLE registrations (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    event_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    student_id VARCHAR(50),
    department VARCHAR(100),
    email VARCHAR(100),
    year VARCHAR(50),
    notes TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

This creates:

  • database: event_registration_db

  • table: registrations

2. Make your project folder

Example structure:

Bash
event-registration/
│
├── public/
│   └── index.html
│
├── server.js
├── package.json

3. Install required Node packages

Open terminal inside your project folder and run:

Bash
npm init -y
npm install express mysql2 cors

These are used for:

  • express → backend server

  • mysql2 → connect Node.js to MySQL

  • cors → allow frontend to talk to backend

4. Create backend file server.js

Paste this code into server.js:

JavaScript
const express = require("express");
const mysql = require("mysql2");
const cors = require("cors");

const app = express();
const PORT = 3000;

// Middleware
app.use(cors());
app.use(express.json());
app.use(express.static("public"));

// MySQL connection
const db = mysql.createConnection({
  host: "localhost",
  user: "root",
  password: "YOUR_MYSQL_PASSWORD",
  database: "event_registration_db"
});

// Connect to MySQL
db.connect((err) => {
  if (err) {
    console.error("MySQL connection failed:", err);
    return;
  }
  console.log("Connected to MySQL database");
});

// API route for registration
app.post("/register", (req, res) => {
  const {
    fullName,
    eventName,
    studentId,
    department,
    email,
    year,
    notes
  } = req.body;

  const sql = `
    INSERT INTO registrations
    (full_name, event_name, student_id, department, email, year, notes)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `;

  db.query(
    sql,
    [fullName, eventName, studentId, department, email, year, notes],
    (err, result) => {
      if (err) {
        console.error("Error inserting data:", err);
        return res.status(500).json({ message: "Database error" });
      }

      res.json({ message: "Registration successful" });
    }
  );
});

// Start server
app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`Server running at http://localhost:${PORT}`);
});

5. Important: put your MySQL password correctly

In this part:

JavaScript
password: "YOUR_MYSQL_PASSWORD",

replace it with your real MySQL password.

Example:

JavaScript
password: "root123"

If your MySQL has no password, use:

JavaScript
password: ""

6. Update your frontend HTML

Inside your public/index.html, use this version of the script part so form data goes to backend.

You can keep your UI design, but your form fields must have these IDs:

  • fullName

  • eventName

  • studentId

  • department

  • email

  • year

  • notes

Use this full HTML if needed:

HTML
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Event Registration</title>
  <style>
    body {
      font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
      background: #1f2330;
      color: white;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      min-height: 100vh;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .container {
      width: 420px;
      background: #2b3142;
      padding: 25px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    }

    h2 {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    input, select, textarea, button {
      width: 100%;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      padding: 12px;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 8px;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    input, select, textarea {
      background: #40485e;
      color: white;
    }

    button {
      background: #7c8db5;
      color: white;
      font-weight: bold;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    button:hover {
      background: #93a6d0;
    }

    #message {
      text-align: center;
      margin-top: 10px;
      font-weight: bold;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="container">
    <h2>Event Registration</h2>

    <form id="registrationForm">
      <input type="text" id="fullName" placeholder="Full Name" required />
      <input type="text" id="studentId" placeholder="Student ID" />
      <input type="text" id="department" placeholder="Department" />
      <input type="email" id="email" placeholder="Email" />
      
      <select id="year">
        <option value="">Select Year</option>
        <option>1st Year</option>
        <option>2nd Year</option>
        <option>3rd Year</option>
        <option>4th Year</option>
      </select>

      <select id="eventName" required>
        <option value="">Select Event</option>
        <option>Tech Fest</option>
        <option>Cultural Event</option>
        <option>Workshop</option>
        <option>Hackathon</option>
      </select>

      <textarea id="notes" placeholder="Additional Notes"></textarea>

      <button type="submit">Register</button>
    </form>

    <div id="message"></div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const form = document.getElementById("registrationForm");
    const message = document.getElementById("message");

    form.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();

      const data = {
        fullName: document.getElementById("fullName").value,
        studentId: document.getElementById("studentId").value,
        department: document.getElementById("department").value,
        email: document.getElementById("email").value,
        year: document.getElementById("year").value,
        eventName: document.getElementById("eventName").value,
        notes: document.getElementById("notes").value
      };

      try {
        const response = await fetch("/register", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
          },
          body: JSON.stringify(data)
        });

        const result = await response.json();

        if (response.ok) {
          message.style.color = "lightgreen";
          message.textContent = result.message;
          form.reset();
        } else {
          message.style.color = "tomato";
          message.textContent = result.message || "Registration failed";
        }
      } catch (error) {
        message.style.color = "tomato";
        message.textContent = "Server error";
        console.error(error);
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

10. Very important concept

Your frontend never talks directly to MySQL.

It talks to this route:

JavaScript
POST /register

Then backend code inserts into MySQL.

So the chain is:

  • user fills form in browser

  • browser sends JSON data to Node backend

  • Node backend runs SQL query

  • MySQL stores the record

  • backend sends success response

  • frontend shows success message

11. Common errors and fixes

Error: Access denied for user 'root'@'localhost'

Your MySQL username or password is wrong.

Check this part:

JavaScript
user: "root",
password: "your_password"

Error: Unknown database 'event_registration_db'

You did not create the database yet.

Run:

SQL
CREATE DATABASE event_registration_db;

Error: Table 'registrations' doesn't exist

You did not create the table.

Run the CREATE TABLE registrations query.

Error: Cannot GET /

Make sure this line exists:

JavaScript
app.use(express.static("public"));

and your index.html is inside public folder.

Error: fetch failed or no response

Make sure backend is running with:

Bash
node server.js

Step 2: create server.js

JavaScript
const express = require("express");
const mysql = require("mysql2");
const cors = require("cors");
const path = require("path");

const app = express();
const PORT = 3000;

app.use(cors());
app.use(express.json());
app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, "public")));

const db = mysql.createConnection({
  host: "localhost",
  user: "root",
  password: "YOUR_MYSQL_PASSWORD",
  database: "event_registration_db"
});

db.connect((err) => {
  if (err) {
    console.error("MySQL connection failed:", err);
    return;
  }
  console.log("Connected to MySQL database");
});

app.post("/register", (req, res) => {
  const { fullName, eventName, studentId, department, email, year, notes } = req.body;

  const sql = `
    INSERT INTO registrations
    (full_name, event_name, student_id, department, email, year, notes)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `;

  db.query(
    sql,
    [fullName, eventName, studentId, department, email, year, notes],
    (err, result) => {
      if (err) {
        console.error("Insert error:", err);
        return res.status(500).json({ message: "Database error" });
      }

      res.json({ message: "Registration successful" });
    }
  );
});

app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`Server running at http://localhost:${PORT}`);
});

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <title>Event Registration</title>
  <style>
    body {
      font-family: Arial;
      background: #1f2330;
      color: white;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      height: 100vh;
    }

    .box {
      background: #2b3142;
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      width: 300px;
    }

    input, select, textarea {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 10px;
      margin: 8px 0;
      border-radius: 5px;
      border: none;
    }

    button {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 10px;
      background: #7c8db5;
      color: white;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    button:hover {
      background: #93a6d0;
    }

    #msg {
      margin-top: 10px;
      text-align: center;
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <div class="box">
    <h2>Register Event</h2>

    <form id="form">
      <input id="fullName" placeholder="Full Name" required>
      <input id="studentId" placeholder="Student ID">
      <input id="department" placeholder="Department">
      <input id="email" placeholder="Email">

      <select id="year">
        <option>1st Year</option>
        <option>2nd Year</option>
      </select>

      <select id="eventName" required>
        <option>Tech Fest</option>
        <option>Workshop</option>
      </select>

      <textarea id="notes" placeholder="Notes"></textarea>

      <button type="submit">Register</button>
    </form>

    <div id="msg"></div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const form = document.getElementById("form");
    const msg = document.getElementById("msg");

    form.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();

      const data = {
        fullName: document.getElementById("fullName").value,
        studentId: document.getElementById("studentId").value,
        department: document.getElementById("department").value,
        email: document.getElementById("email").value,
        year: document.getElementById("year").value,
        eventName: document.getElementById("eventName").value,
        notes: document.getElementById("notes").value
      };

      const res = await fetch("/register", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(data)
      });

      const result = await res.json();

      msg.innerText = result.message;
      form.reset();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

HTML
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <title>Event Registration</title>
  <style>
    body {
      font-family: Arial;
      background: #1f2330;
      color: white;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      height: 100vh;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .box {
      background: #2b3142;
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      width: 320px;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    }

    input, select, textarea {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 10px;
      margin: 8px 0;
      border-radius: 5px;
      border: none;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    button {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 10px;
      background: #7c8db5;
      color: white;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    button:hover {
      background: #93a6d0;
    }

    #msg {
      margin-top: 10px;
      text-align: center;
      font-weight: bold;
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <div class="box">
    <h2>Register Event</h2>

    <form id="form">
      <input id="fullName" placeholder="Full Name" required>
      <input id="studentId" placeholder="Student ID">
      <input id="department" placeholder="Department">
      <input id="email" placeholder="Email">

      <select id="year">
        <option value="">Select Year</option>
        <option>1st Year</option>
        <option>2nd Year</option>
        <option>3rd Year</option>
        <option>4th Year</option>
      </select>

      <select id="eventName" required>
        <option value="">Select Event</option>
        <option>Tech Fest</option>
        <option>Workshop</option>
        <option>Cultural Event</option>
        <option>Hackathon</option>
      </select>

      <textarea id="notes" placeholder="Notes"></textarea>

      <button type="submit">Register</button>
    </form>

    <div id="msg"></div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const form = document.getElementById("form");
    const msg = document.getElementById("msg");

    form.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();

      const data = {
        fullName: document.getElementById("fullName").value,
        studentId: document.getElementById("studentId").value,
        department: document.getElementById("department").value,
        email: document.getElementById("email").value,
        year: document.getElementById("year").value,
        eventName: document.getElementById("eventName").value,
        notes: document.getElementById("notes").value
      };

      try {
        const res = await fetch("/register", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
          },
          body: JSON.stringify(data)
        });

        const result = await res.json();
        msg.innerText = result.message;
        form.reset();
      } catch (err) {
        msg.innerText = "Server error";
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

    }

      padding: 50px 40px;

      border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      display: flex;

    }

      display: inline-block;

    }

    }

    }

      border-radius: 16px;

<body>
  <div class="bg-circle bg1"></div>
  <div class="bg-circle bg2"></div>

  <div class="container">
    <div class="left-panel">
      <div class="badge">Cloud-Ready Campus Portal</div>
      <h1>Register for the <span>next big campus event</span></h1>
      <p>
        A modern event registration experience for university students.
        Join tech fests, workshops, hackathons, and cultural events through a sleek digital portal.
      </p>

      <div class="highlights">
        <div class="highlight">
          <strong>Fast Registration</strong>
          <span>Submit your details in seconds through a clean and interactive form.</span>
        </div>
        <div class="highlight">
          <strong>Event Ready</strong>
          <span>Built for Tech Fest, Cultural Events, Workshops, Seminars, and more.</span>
        </div>
        <div class="highlight">
          <strong>Future Scalable</strong>
          <span>Designed for backend integration, database storage, and cloud deployment.</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="right-panel">
      <div class="form-header">
        <h2>Student Registration Form</h2>
        <p>Fill in your details to reserve your spot for the event.</p>
      </div>

      <form id="form">
        <div class="field">
          <label for="fullName">Full Name</label>
          <input type="text" id="fullName" placeholder="Enter your full name" required>
        </div>

        <div class="row">
          <div class="field">
            <label for="studentId">Student ID</label>
            <input type="text" id="studentId" placeholder="Enter student ID">
          </div>

          <div class="field">
            <label for="department">Department</label>
            <input type="text" id="department" placeholder="Enter department">
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="row">
          <div class="field">
            <label for="email">Email Address</label>
            <input type="email" id="email" placeholder="Enter university email">
          </div>

          <div class="field">
            <label for="year">Year</label>
            <select id="year">
              <option value="">Select Year</option>
              <option>1st Year</option>
              <option>2nd Year</option>
              <option>3rd Year</option>
              <option>4th Year</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="field">
          <label for="eventName">Event Name</label>
          <select id="eventName" required>
            <option value="">Select Event</option>
            <option>Tech Fest</option>
            <option>Workshop</option>
            <option>Cultural Event</option>
            <option>Hackathon</option>
            <option>Seminar</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div class="field">
          <label for="notes">Additional Notes</label>
          <textarea id="notes" placeholder="Any message or request"></textarea>
        </div>

        <button type="submit" class="submit-btn">Register Now</button>

        <div id="msg"></div>

        <div class="footer-note">
          University event registration portal • Frontend upgrade without backend changes
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const form = document.getElementById("form");
    const msg = document.getElementById("msg");

    form.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();

      const data = {
        fullName: document.getElementById("fullName").value,
        studentId: document.getElementById("studentId").value,
        department: document.getElementById("department").value,
        email: document.getElementById("email").value,
        year: document.getElementById("year").value,
        eventName: document.getElementById("eventName").value,
        notes: document.getElementById("notes").value
      };

      try {
        const res = await fetch("/register", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
          },
          body: JSON.stringify(data)
        });

        const result = await res.json();

        if (res.ok) {
          msg.className = "success";
          msg.innerText = result.message;
          form.reset();
        } else {
          msg.className = "error";
          msg.innerText = result.message || "Registration failed";
        }
      } catch (err) {
        msg.className = "error";
        msg.innerText = "Server error";
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

Step 1: add a route in server.js

Open server.js and add this code below your /register route and above app.listen(...):

JavaScript
app.get("/registrations", (req, res) => {
  const sql = "SELECT * FROM registrations ORDER BY id DESC";

  db.query(sql, (err, results) => {
    if (err) {
      console.error("Fetch error:", err);
      return res.status(500).json({ message: "Database fetch error" });
    }

    res.json(results);
  });
});

So your server.js will now have:

  • POST /register → save data

  • GET /registrations → show all data

HTML
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Admin Dashboard - Registrations</title>
  <style>
    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #161a25, #1f2533, #2b3245);
      color: white;
      min-height: 100vh;
      padding: 30px;
    }

    .container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: auto;
    }

    .topbar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 25px;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .title h1 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 2rem;
    }

    .title p {
      margin: 6px 0 0;
      color: #cbd5e1;
    }

    .actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .btn {
      text-decoration: none;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      background: #7c8db5;
      color: white;
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    .btn:hover {
      background: #93a6d0;
    }

    .card {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 20px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    }

    table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      min-width: 950px;
    }

    th, td {
      padding: 14px 12px;
      text-align: left;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      vertical-align: top;
    }

    th {
      color: #dbeafe;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    }

    tr:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    }

    .empty {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 24px;
      color: #cbd5e1;
    }

    .status {
      margin-top: 14px;
      color: #cbd5e1;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
    }

    @media (max-width: 700px) {
      .title h1 {
        font-size: 1.6rem;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="container">
    <div class="topbar">
      <div class="title">
        <h1>Event Registrations Dashboard</h1>
        <p>View all student event registrations saved in MySQL</p>
      </div>

      <div class="actions">
        <a href="/" class="btn">Go to Registration Form</a>
        <button class="btn" onclick="loadRegistrations()">Refresh Data</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <table id="dataTable">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>ID</th>
            <th>Full Name</th>
            <th>Event Name</th>
            <th>Student ID</th>
            <th>Department</th>
            <th>Email</th>
            <th>Year</th>
            <th>Notes</th>
            <th>Created At</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="tableBody">
          <tr>
            <td colspan="9" class="empty">Loading registrations...</td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>

      <div class="status" id="statusText">Fetching latest data...</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    async function loadRegistrations() {
      const tableBody = document.getElementById("tableBody");
      const statusText = document.getElementById("statusText");

      tableBody.innerHTML = `
        <tr>
          <td colspan="9" class="empty">Loading registrations...</td>
        </tr>
      `;
      statusText.textContent = "Fetching latest data...";

      try {
        const response = await fetch("/registrations");
        const data = await response.json();

        if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length === 0) {
          tableBody.innerHTML = `
            <tr>
              <td colspan="9" class="empty">No registrations found.</td>
            </tr>
          `;
          statusText.textContent = "No records available.";
          return;
        }

        tableBody.innerHTML = data.map(item => `
          <tr>
            <td>${item.id ?? ""}</td>
            <td>${item.full_name ?? ""}</td>
            <td>${item.event_name ?? ""}</td>
            <td>${item.student_id ?? ""}</td>
            <td>${item.department ?? ""}</td>
            <td>${item.email ?? ""}</td>
            <td>${item.year ?? ""}</td>
            <td>${item.notes ?? ""}</td>
            <td>${item.created_at ?? ""}</td>
          </tr>
        `).join("");

        statusText.textContent = `Showing ${data.length} registration(s).`;
      } catch (error) {
        tableBody.innerHTML = `
          <tr>
            <td colspan="9" class="empty">Failed to load registrations.</td>
          </tr>
        `;
        statusText.textContent = "Error while fetching data.";
        console.error(error);
      }
    }

    loadRegistrations();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

HTML
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>Admin Dashboard</title>

  <style>
    body {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #161a25, #1f2533, #2b3245);
      color: white;
      padding: 30px;
    }

    h1 {
      margin-bottom: 5px;
    }

    p {
      color: #cbd5e1;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .topbar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .btn {
      background: #7c8db5;
      color: white;
      border: none;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: none;
      margin-left: 10px;
    }

    .btn:hover {
      background: #93a6d0;
    }

    .table-box {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 20px;
      overflow-x: auto;
    }

    table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      min-width: 900px;
    }

    th, td {
      padding: 12px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      text-align: left;
    }

    th {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }

    tr:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    }

    #status {
      margin-top: 10px;
      color: #cbd5e1;
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>

  <div class="topbar">
    <div>
      <h1>Admin Dashboard</h1>
      <p>View all registered students</p>
    </div>

    <div>
      <a href="/" class="btn">Go to Form</a>
      <button onclick="loadData()" class="btn">Refresh</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="table-box">
    <table>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>ID</th>
          <th>Full Name</th>
          <th>Event</th>
          <th>Student ID</th>
          <th>Department</th>
          <th>Email</th>
          <th>Year</th>
          <th>Notes</th>
          <th>Created At</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>

      <tbody id="tableBody">
        <tr>
          <td colspan="9">Loading...</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <div id="status">Fetching data...</div>
  </div>

  <script>
    async function loadData() {
      const tableBody = document.getElementById("tableBody");
      const status = document.getElementById("status");

      tableBody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='9'>Loading...</td></tr>";
      status.textContent = "Fetching data...";

      try {
        const res = await fetch("/registrations");
        const data = await res.json();

        if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length === 0) {
          tableBody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='9'>No data found</td></tr>";
          status.textContent = "No records found.";
          return;
        }

        tableBody.innerHTML = data.map(item => `
          <tr>
            <td>${item.id}</td>
            <td>${item.full_name}</td>
            <td>${item.event_name}</td>
            <td>${item.student_id}</td>
            <td>${item.department}</td>
            <td>${item.email}</td>
            <td>${item.year}</td>
            <td>${item.notes}</td>
            <td>${item.created_at}</td>
          </tr>
        `).join("");

        status.textContent = "Data loaded successfully";

      } catch (err) {
        tableBody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='9'>Error loading data</td></tr>";
        status.textContent = "Error fetching data";
        console.error(err);
      }
    }

    loadData();
  </script>

</body>
</html>
